amcl:
  ros__parameters:
    use_sim_time: false
    base_frame_id: body
    odom_frame_id: camera_init
    global_frame_id: map
    scan_topic: /localization/scan
    tf_broadcast: true
    set_initial_pose: false
    transform_tolerance: 0.20

    robot_model_type: nav2_amcl::DifferentialMotionModel
    alpha1: 0.05
    alpha2: 0.05
    alpha3: 0.05
    alpha4: 0.05
    alpha5: 0.02

    laser_model_type: likelihood_field
    laser_min_range: 0.20
    laser_max_range: 20.0
    laser_likelihood_max_dist: 2.0
    max_beams: 180
    sigma_hit: 0.20
    z_hit: 0.75
    z_rand: 0.20
    z_short: 0.025
    z_max: 0.025
    do_beamskip: true
    beam_skip_distance: 0.50
    beam_skip_threshold: 0.30
    beam_skip_error_threshold: 0.90

    min_particles: 500
    max_particles: 2000
    pf_err: 0.05
    pf_z: 0.99
    resample_interval: 1
    recovery_alpha_fast: 0.0
    recovery_alpha_slow: 0.0
    save_pose_rate: 0.5
    update_min_a: 0.05
    update_min_d: 0.05

/**:
  ros__parameters:
    target_frame: body
    transform_tolerance: 0.10
    min_height: -0.25
    max_height: 0.80
    angle_min: -3.141592653589793
    angle_max: 3.141592653589793
    angle_increment: 0.008726646259972
    scan_time: 0.10
    range_min: 0.20
    range_max: 20.0
    use_inf: true
    inf_epsilon: 1.0
    queue_size: 1

/**:
  ros__parameters:
    feature_extract_enable: false
    point_filter_num: 3
    max_iteration: 3
    filter_size_surf: 0.5
    filter_size_map: 0.5
    cube_side_length: 1000.0
    runtime_pos_log_enable: true
    map_file_path: "/home/agilex/competition_rebuild_ws/maps/fast_lio/day1_fast_lio.pcd"

    common:
      lid_topic: "/livox/lidar"
      imu_topic: "/livox/imu"
      time_sync_en: false
      time_offset_lidar_to_imu: 0.0

    preprocess:
      lidar_type: 1
      scan_line: 4
      blind: 0.5
      timestamp_unit: 3
      scan_rate: 10

    mapping:
      acc_cov: 0.1
      gyr_cov: 0.1
      b_acc_cov: 0.0001
      b_gyr_cov: 0.0001
      fov_degree: 360.0
      det_range: 100.0
      # Keep the calibrated LiDAR-IMU extrinsic fixed during runtime localization.
      extrinsic_est_en: false
      extrinsic_T: [-0.011, -0.02329, 0.04412]
      extrinsic_R: [1., 0., 0., 0., 1., 0., 0., 0., 1.]

    publish:
      path_en: true
      effect_map_en: false
      map_en: true
      scan_publish_en: true
      dense_publish_en: false
      scan_bodyframe_pub_en: true

    pcd_save:
      pcd_save_en: false
      interval: -1
